ayahs.tj: إِذَا ٱلشَّمْسُ كُوِّرَتْ ١
ayahs.en: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ ٱنكَدَرَتْ ٢
ayahs.en: And when the stars fall, dispersing,

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْجِبَالُ سُيِّرَتْ ٣
ayahs.en: And when the mountains are removed

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْعِشَارُ عُطِّلَتْ ٤
ayahs.en: And when full-term she-camels are neglected

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْوُحُوشُ حُشِرَتْ ٥
ayahs.en: And when the wild beasts are gathered

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْبِحَارُ سُجِّرَتْ ٦
ayahs.en: And when the seas are filled with flame

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلنُّفُوسُ زُوِّجَتْ ٧
ayahs.en: And when the souls are paired

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْمَوْءُۥدَةُ سُئِلَتْ ٨
ayahs.en: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked

ayahs.tj: بِأَىِّ ذَنۢبٍ قُتِلَتْ ٩
ayahs.en: For what sin she was killed

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتْ ١٠
ayahs.en: And when the pages are made public

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلسَّمَآءُ كُشِطَتْ ١١
ayahs.en: And when the sky is stripped away

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتْ ١٢
ayahs.en: And when Hellfire is set ablaze

ayahs.tj: وَإِذَا ٱلْجَنَّةُ أُزْلِفَتْ ١٣
ayahs.en: And when Paradise is brought near,

ayahs.tj: عَلِمَتْ نَفْسٌ مَّآ أَحْضَرَتْ ١٤
ayahs.en: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].

ayahs.tj: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِٱلْخُنَّسِ ١٥
ayahs.en: So I swear by the retreating stars -

ayahs.tj: ٱلْجَوَارِ ٱلْكُنَّسِ ١٦
ayahs.en: Those that run [their courses] and disappear -

ayahs.tj: وَٱلَّيْلِ إِذَا عَسْعَسَ ١٧
ayahs.en: And by the night as it closes in

ayahs.tj: وَٱلصُّبْحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ ١٨
ayahs.en: And by the dawn when it breathes

ayahs.tj: إِنَّهُۥ لَقَوْلُ رَسُولٍ كَرِيمٍ ١٩
ayahs.en: [That] indeed, the Qur'an is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger

ayahs.ar: ذى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى العَرشِ مَكينٍ
ayahs.tj: ذِى قُوَّةٍ عِندَ ذِى ٱلْعَرْشِ مَكِينٍ ٢٠
ayahs.en: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],

ayahs.tj: مُّطَاعٍ ثَمَّ أَمِينٍ ٢١
ayahs.en: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.

ayahs.tj: وَمَا صَاحِبُكُم بِمَجْنُونٍ ٢٢
ayahs.en: And your companion is not [at all] mad.

ayahs.tj: وَلَقَدْ رَءَاهُ بِٱلْأُفُقِ ٱلْمُبِينِ ٢٣
ayahs.en: And he has already seen Gabriel in the clear horizon.

ayahs.tj: وَمَا هُوَ عَلَى ٱلْغَيْبِ بِضَنِينٍ ٢٤
ayahs.en: And Muhammad is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.

ayahs.tj: وَمَا هُوَ بِقَوْلِ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ ٢٥
ayahs.en: And the Qur'an is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].

ayahs.tj: فَأَيْنَ تَذْهَبُونَ ٢٦
ayahs.en: So where are you going?

ayahs.tj: إِنْ هُوَ إِلَّا ذِكْرٌ لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ٢٧
ayahs.en: It is not except a reminder to the worlds

ayahs.tj: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمْ أَن يَسْتَقِيمَ ٢٨
ayahs.en: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.

ayahs.ar: وَما تَشاءونَ إِلّا أَن يَشاءَ اللَّهُ رَبُّ العٰلَمينَ
ayahs.tj: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ ٢٩
ayahs.en: And you do not will except that Allah wills - Lord of the worlds.
